SonicRatings is a tool that **syncs external track popularity/rating data to Navidrome/Subsonic music library ratings**. Here's the core functionality:

- **Provider-based scoring**: Connects to Spotify, TIDAL, Last.fm, MusicBrainz, or Discogs to fetch popularity or rating data for tracks in your music library
- **Rating translation**: Converts these external scores into a 0-5 star rating system that Navidrome can display
- **Navidrome integration**: Updates personal track ratings on the server via the Subsonic API
- **Smart playlists**: Designed to work alongside [navidrome-smart-playlists](https://github.com/SickProdigy/navidrome-smart-playlists) to build dynamic playlists of highly rated music by genre or decade

In short, it's a music library enhancement that populates Navidrome's rating system with data from external music databases, giving you a quick way to identify popular tracks in your library.

The project is at [https://github.com/SickProdigy/SonicRatings](https://github.com/SickProdigy/SonicRatings).

I have the complete README in hand if you want to know more about the setup, configuration, or any specific feature.

I've reviewed the full project: [Sick-Cogs](https://github.com/SickProdigy/Sick-Cogs) is a Red-DiscordBot collection with cogs for Steam announcements, role management (RoleTools, GameRoles), music, gaming, token generation, donations, giveaways, and more. The project is well-structured with a stable `main` and work on `develop`.

One thing that would be genuinely useful and is missing is a **music player/cowder**. There's a movies announcement cog, a music library integration (SonicRatings), and even a donate system for music — but no actual audio playback. Most Discord music utilities in this space are independent bots rather than cogs; having one here would fit the ecosystem.

A focused music player cog could:

- **Queue audio** from YouTube, SoundCloud, and local files — standard features like `play <query>`, `queue <url>`, `pause`, `resume`, `stop`, `skip`, `shuffle`, `remove <number>`.
- **Follow the queue** when users join/leave, so they can pick up what's being played.
- **Channel/topic-based per server** — each Discord server has its own queue and playback.
- **Volume and filtering** controls (volume up/down, volume, filters like `dub`, `fade`, `noise`, `filter <name>`).
- **Audio source management** — `addsource <url>`, `remove <source>`, `sources`.
- **Music history** — `history`, `recent`, `replay <title>`, `rewind`.
- **Permissions** — admin roles can queue, normal users can only play, etc.

It would complement SonicRatings nicely (SonicRatings populates Navidrome ratings; the player lets users listen). It's practical, non-controversial, and has broad value in Discord music communities.

**SonicRatings** (`sickprodigy/SonicRatings`) is a Python script that syncs track popularity and community ratings from external providers into your Navidrome or Subsonic-compatible music library.

**What it does:**
- Pulls ratings from Spotify, TIDAL, Last.fm, MusicBrainz, and Discogs
- Maps those provider scores into Navidrome library star ratings
- Designed to give new utility to the star ratings in Navidrome (which many users leave unused in favor of favorites)
- Works alongside [`navidrome-smart-playlists`](https://github.com/sickprodigy/navidrome-smart-playlists) — SonicRatings supplies the ratings, and the playlists use them to build dynamic playlists of highly rated music by genre or decade
- Originally forked from **SPTNR** (Spotify Popularity to Navidrome Ratings), then forked again to this repo
